svg.title: What I work on: Agentic orchestration: Multi-agent workflows in LangGraph and n8n, MCP tool calling, schema-validated outputs; Cloud infrastructure: AWS as code with Terraform: VPCs, ECS Fargate, Lambda, RDS, least-privilege IAM; CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, Docker, Ansible, Prometheus and Grafana; LLM evals & observability: Langfuse tracing, cost and latency per call, automated evals and regression sets
